articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas , Jan. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- EZCORP, Inc. (NASDAQ:EZPW) (“EZCORP” or the “Company”), a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States and Latin America , announced today the acquisition of a controlling interest in Founders One, LLC (“Founders”).
